content.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

Position Overview

HighLevel is hiring a fully remote Systems Support Specialist II to join our IT team. This role covers the afternoon shift (2:00 PM – 10:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday) and is responsible for day-to-day administration, support, and troubleshooting across our core collaboration, identity, and endpoint management systems.

The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable owning escalated tickets end-to-end, and proficient across a modern SaaS-based IT stack spanning identity/device management, collaboration tools, and workflow/access tooling.

This person will be the sole internal IT team member covering this shift. Strong independent judgment and ownership are essential. They will also serve as the direct escalation point for our L1 MSP when a ticket needs to be escalated beyond L1 during shift hours.
Key Responsibilities
Provide Tier 1/2 IT support to employees across multiple regions, resolving tickets related to accounts, devices, access, and collaboration tools.

Support Google Workspace (user accounts, groups, google drive, google apps troubleshooting, investigation and reporting) administration.

Manage device enrollment, configuration, and compliance policies via JumpCloud and Addigy for macOS/mobile endpoints

Familiar with Apple Business Manager regarding device procurement, enrollment, and app deployment.

Administer Slack and should have hands on knowledge of slack enterprise edition. Should be able to import/export data, manage roles/permissions, audit logs and solve access level issues without any guidance.

Zoom administration - audit issues, audit access reviews, check collaborations

Manage access requests, workflows, and identity governance tasks in Tuebora.

Provide user support for ClickUp related issues before escalating to our account manager.

Perform employee offboarding tasks (access deprovisioning) if scheduled during shift.

Maintain accurate documentation of IT processes, configurations, and troubleshooting steps

Escalate and coordinate with other IT team members on complex issues outside normal scope.

Ensure consistent coverage and responsiveness during the assigned shift window.

Serve as the sole IT team member on shift and the direct escalation point for our L1 MSP, handling tickets they escalate beyond L1 during these hours.
Required Technical Skills
Candidates must be proficient with the following tools:

Google Workspace: Admin console, investigate logs, provide reports and perform user/group management.

Slack: Administration, user/channel management, integrations

Zoom: Administration and troubleshooting

ClickUp: Task and ticket management

Tuebora: Identity governance and access management workflows

JumpCloud: Directory services, device/identity management

Addigy: macOS device management (MDM), policy enforcement, patching

Apple Business Manager: Device enrollment, procurement, app/content deployment

Hands-on, working proficiency with each of the above is required. This is not a role for someone who has only used one or two of these tools.
Qualifications & Experience
3-5 years of experience in an IT support, systems administration, or help desk engineering role.

Demonstrated experience administering SaaS identity and endpoint management platforms (e.g., JumpCloud, Addigy, or comparable MDM/UEM tools).

Experience with Apple device management and Apple Business Manager.

Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable supporting employees across multiple regions/time zones.

Prior experience supporting a distributed or global workforce is a plus.

Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+/Network+, JumpCloud Core, Apple Certified Support Professional) are a plus but not required.
Work Schedule & Location
Location: Fully remote (Mexico)

Schedule: Afternoon shift, 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM CST, standard business days

Reliable high-speed internet and a distraction-free home work environment required

Must be able to work the full shift consistently, with occasional overlap for handoffs or escalations as needed
